text: Your girlfriend cheated on you and now you find it hard to trust women. How to learn to trust them again? Good afternoon, sir. I hope you're doing well. I'm not sure what the process is to ask you questions so I'm just doing it via Instagram as it is more convenient. Sadly, my ex broke up with me in November last year and I found out about one and a half months ago that it was because she was cheating on me and she left me for her now current boyfriend. So let me stop right here. How did you even find this out? Your ex broke up with you six months ago and for all this time you monitored her or stayed in contact or how did you find out that she cheated on you? Guys, if you broke up, that is it. Out of heart, out of mind. Even if you broke up on good terms, you are better off cutting all contacts, moving on with your life and focusing on yourself. I thankfully have moved on and chosen my own peace but I'm struggling with trusting women in the future. My question to you is how do I learn to trust women again while still protecting my heart? Thank you and have a great rest of your day. You see, the way you frame this, you're kind of shifting the blame on your ex and don't get me wrong, she is guilty. She did betray you and it's good that you moved on but you need to understand this. You are guilty too because you didn't see the red flags and I can almost guarantee you they were there. You either didn't notice them or you noticed them and didn't want to acknowledge them and I'm sure that now looking back at your story, knowing that she cheated, you can think of a few inconsistencies or things that didn't add up. So the question you should be asking is not how can I trust women again. It is how do I build the knowledge and experience to spot those inconsistencies. That is your best shield from ending up in a situation like this again because once you can see the things that don't add up, you can openly bring them up and either, for example, your new girl has answers or she doesn't. If she does, great. If she doesn't, that is your signal that something is probably off and you are better off walking away and moving on. The knowledge you can get by watching my channel or whoever you trust. For example, I have my men's main rule series where I talk about the principles a man should live by and the relationship stories on the channel show you how not to behave in certain situations and how to react to certain things. Knowledge, I can give you. Experience, you have to get yourself. So go live your life. Ask the girls out. Go on dates. Have fun. But now apply the knowledge you have.
